scripts.deploy:staging: npm run ci && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run ci && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply lexiflow-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply lexiflow-production --remote --env production
scripts.check:config: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/production
